datasets.title: Public Opinion Poll Data 2020 (965DataGate)
datasets.description: Licensed public opinion polling data for the 2020 election cycle indexed in CLIO catalog under key 965DataGate.

datasets.title: Numeric Data Collection (965DataGate)
datasets.description: Columbia licensed numeric economic and social datasets searchable in CLIO catalog using key index 965DataGate.

datasets.title: NASA Earth Science & Climate Open Datasets
datasets.description: Open source satellite data and climate observations from NASA. Note: Open source datasets do not have standard CLIO records.

datasets.title: HCUP Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project
datasets.description: Restricted hospital inpatient and outpatient medical campus dataset. Paid by faculty across Morningside & Medical campuses.

datasets.title: L2 Micro-Level Election Voter Data
datasets.description: Granular micro-level voter registration and turnout dataset managed by Population Research Center (CPRC). Not in CLIO.

datasets.title: IPUMS Restricted Access Full Count US Census (1790-1950)
datasets.description: Full count US decennial census microdata (1790-1950) managed by CPRC & CUIT. Excluded from default CLIO search.

datasets.title: Licensed Geospatial & Spatial Analytics Datasets
datasets.description: Licensed GIS spatial boundaries and satellite layers managed by Eric.

datasets.title: Textual & Computational Linguistics Corpus
datasets.description: Licensed text mining, linguistic corpora, and digital humanities datasets managed by Moacir.

datasets.title: US Decennial Census Microdata 2020
datasets.description: Granular census tract and demographic cross-tabulations from US Census Bureau indexed via CLIO 965DataGate.

datasets.title: IPUMS USA Microdata Samples
datasets.description: High-precision census and American Community Survey microdata hosted on Redivis Columbia Data Platform.

libguides.title: Data Analysis Tools Guide
libguides.description: Includes two bio-stats books by Rafael A. Irizarry under the 'R' tab, tailored for Medical Campus R users.

libguides.title: Numeric Data Collection Guide
libguides.description: Index of Columbia licensed datasets searchable in CLIO via 965DataGate and migrating to Redivis CDP.
